author: barbo1
quote:
A zero due to waiting 13 years of our lives for a franchise dissapointing us on so many levels. Having an amazing map and game that is so graphicly demanding that it caps at 30 fps at launch is still understandable, but destroying the open world crime simulation by restricting our ability to do certain crimes is very dissapointing, the absence of female sex  workers in Grant theft auto is also a completly incomprehensible and baffling decision that clashes with the series own identity. Story wise Jason feels bland and boring, "not a real person" tbh, main story itself its not the best nor the worst, but predictable and a bit woke. Grant theft auto used to be about pushing boundaries in all aspects of the game and freedom to do everything like a real open world crime simulator. Being restricted or having the game actively stop you, takes away from the immersion itself, and from the gta expirience we where used to.
Honest take a great job on the games development and massive leap in graphical advancements and engineering, but a terrible job in the games story choice and restrictions.
